head_commit.message:
Qualify the reviewed Ferocity token receiver under the unchanged bounded gates

Bind the unspent source08 browser attempt and original 27-stage priority gate to the complete receiving source. Preserve all four browser cases, zero retries, the original 508-case bank, every frozen experimental input, and earlier failed and accepted component evidence.

Receive canonical token-defender and entry-event provenance fixes only after their original 16 plus separate four cases passed and root independently accepted the raw artifact. Preserve Ferocity current combat and Gift behavior. Root independently accepted the receiving source; Izzet independently accepted the final browser and 210-source priority binding. Sphinx independently reviewed the read-only runtime relocation helper. These are named non-author agent reviews, not GitHub approvals.

Exactly one next push from d097 may execute source08. Later evidence commits and workflow reruns cannot consume another browser attempt. Full receiving CI, actual artifacts, complete runtime/admission and the original first 16 D2 games remain separate; no official game, outcome or calibration allocation is consumed by this commit.

Published tree is byte-identical to local reviewed assembly f31effad6c64b01f2100f9c97e296265a11f8687 (tree 56c6b8dd46dc112cdb70db496fd9d0c3e915e8a6). The intermediate local review identities remain source candidates documented by exact file hashes.

sourceWorkflow.content:
name: Engine Priority After Resolution

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/engine-priority-after-resolution.yml
      - docs/engine-priority-after-resolution*
      - docs/experiments/pest-control/tier-one-postboard-engine-priority-sources.json
      - docs/experiments/pest-control/tier-one-postboard-engine-priority-shared-receiving-sources.json
      - lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/priority-receiving-sources.json
      - lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/collect-priority-receiving.py
      - rules-engine/src/testFixtures/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/support/TriggerOrderTestSupport.kt
      - rules-engine/src/main/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/state/GameState.kt
      - rules-engine/src/main/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/handlers/ContinuationHandler.kt
      - rules-engine/src/main/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/handlers/actions/priority/PassPriorityHandler.kt
      - rules-engine/src/main/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/handlers/actions/decision/SubmitDecisionHandler.kt
      - rules-engine/src/main/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/mechanics/sba/player/PlayerLeavesGameProcessor.kt
      - rules-engine/src/test/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/scenarios/StackResolutionPriorityTest.kt
      - mtg-sets/2000-2002/tests/src/test/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/scenarios/CircleOfSolaceTest.kt
      - mtg-sets/1993-1999/tests/src/test/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/scenarios/ScarecrowScenarioTest.kt
      - mtg-sets/2008-2016/tests/src/test/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/scenarios/AbundantMawScenarioTest.kt
      - mtg-sets/2008-2016/tests/src/test/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/scenarios/SpellQuellerScenarioTest.kt
      - mtg-sets/2008-2016/tests/src/test/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/scenarios/TaureanMaulerScenarioTest.kt
      - ai/src/test/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/ai/engine/DecisionResponderCompletedBranchTest.kt
      - rules-engine/src/testFixtures/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/support/ScenarioTestBase.kt

      - docs/engine-post-cast-sba*
      - rules-engine/src/main/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/event/DeathAndLeaveTriggerDetector.kt
      - rules-engine/src/test/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/scenarios/DeathTriggerTest.kt
      - mtg-sets/2003-2007/tests/src/test/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/scenarios/KrarksThumbScenarioTest.kt
      - mtg-sets/2026/tests/src/test/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/scenarios/PrismariTheInspirationScenarioTest.kt
      - rules-engine/src/main/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/state/PendingCastPriority.kt
      - rules-engine/src/main/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/mechanics/CastPriorityProcessor.kt
      - rules-engine/src/main/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/core/ColorAndTypeContinuations.kt
      - rules-engine/src/main/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/handlers/actions/spell/CastSpellHandler.kt

      - rules-engine/src/main/kotlin/com/wingedsheep/engine/handlers/actions/special/SpecialActionsModule.kt

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  qualify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6
      - name: Bind exact source and effective rules archive
        env:
          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          SOURCE_MANIFEST: lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/priority-receiving-sources.json
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import datetime, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, urllib.request
          root = pathlib.Path('.')
          out = root / 'build/reports/engine-priority-after-resolution'
          out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
          manifest_path = root / os.environ['SOURCE_MANIFEST']
          manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
          head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
          # Record rejected bindings too; a failed source guard is evidence.
          observed = {path: hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                      if (root / path).is_file() else None
                      for path in manifest['source_files_sha256']}
          (out / 'source-manifest.json').write_bytes(manifest_path.read_bytes())
          (out / 'binding-attempt.json').write_text(json.dumps({
              'candidate_head': head, 'expected_head': os.environ['EXPECTED_HEAD'],
              'github_run_id': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'],
              'github_run_attempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
              'manifest_path': str(manifest_path),
              'manifest_sha256': hashlib.sha256(manifest_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              'expected_source_files_sha256': manifest['source_files_sha256'],
              'observed_source_files_sha256': observed,
              'scope': 'DETERMINISTIC_RULES_REGRESSION_ONLY',
              'official_execution_authorized': False,
          }, indent=2) + '\n')
          assert head == os.environ['EXPECTED_HEAD']
          subprocess.check_call(['git', 'merge-base', '--is-ancestor', manifest['base_commit'], head])
          for path, digest in manifest['source_files_sha256'].items():
              assert observed[path] == digest, path
          for item in manifest['preserved_manifests']:
              assert hashlib.sha256((root / item['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == item['sha256'], item['path']
          rules = manifest['rules']
          request = urllib.request.Request(rules['source_url'], headers={'User-Agent': 'Argentum-rules-validation/1.0'})
          with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response:
              raw = response.read()
          (out / 'effective-rules.txt').write_bytes(raw)
          assert len(raw) == rules['byte_length']
          assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == rules['sha256']
          verified_date = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).date().isoformat()
          assert rules['effective_date'] <= verified_date
          provenance = {
              'schema': 'engine-priority-after-resolution-validation-v1',
              'candidate_head': head, 'base_commit': manifest['base_commit'],
              'github_run_id': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'],
              'github_run_attempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
              'github_event_name': os.environ['GITHUB_EVENT_NAME'],
              'manifest_sha256': hashlib.sha256(manifest_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              'source_files_sha256': manifest['source_files_sha256'], 'rules': rules,
              'rules_verified_utc_date': verified_date,
              'scope': 'DETERMINISTIC_RULES_REGRESSION_ONLY',
              'official_seeds_generated': 0, 'official_games_initialized': 0,
              'official_actions_submitted': 0, 'outcome_exposure': 0,
              'official_execution_authorized': False,
          }
          (out / 'source-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance, indent=2) + '\n')
          (out / 'source-manifest.json').write_bytes(manifest_path.read_bytes())
          PY
      - name: Qualify ordinary, post-cast and paused priority boundaries
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          run_stage() {
            local stage="$1" test_class="$2" module="${3:-rules-engine}" status=0
            scripts/test-class "$test_class" --info --stacktrace || status=$?
            local dest="build/reports/engine-priority-after-resolution/tests/$stage"
            mkdir -p "$dest" || return 1
            if [ -d "$module/build/test-results/test" ]; then
              cp -R "$module/build/test-results/test/." "$dest/" || return 1
            else
              printf '%s\n' "Missing XML for $test_class" >&2
              return 1
            fi
            printf '%s\n' "$status" > "$dest/exit-status.txt" || return 1
            return "$status"
          }
          failed=0
          run_stage priority StackResolutionPriorityTest || failed=1
          run_stage stack-war StackWarTest || failed=1
          run_stage continuations ContinuationSystemTest || failed=1
          run_stage ordinary-cleanup CleanupHandSizeDiscardDamageRemovalTest || failed=1
          run_stage legend-rule LegendRuleTest || failed=1
          run_stage leave-game LeaveTheGameTest || failed=1
          run_stage team-priority TwoHeadedGiantTeamPriorityTest || failed=1
          run_stage flash-permission ConditionalFlashGrantTest || failed=1
          run_stage legacy-traces SuspensionTraceTest || failed=1
          run_stage legacy-serialization LegacySuspensionMigrationTest || failed=1
          run_stage circle-solace CircleOfSolaceTest mtg-sets/2000-2002/tests || failed=1
          run_stage scarecrow ScarecrowScenarioTest mtg-sets/1993-1999/tests || failed=1
          run_stage abundant-maw AbundantMawScenarioTest mtg-sets/2008-2016/tests || failed=1
          run_stage spell-queller SpellQuellerScenarioTest mtg-sets/2008-2016/tests || failed=1
          run_stage mauler TaureanMaulerScenarioTest mtg-sets/2008-2016/tests || failed=1
          run_stage ai-decision-trace DecisionResponderCompletedBranchTest ai || failed=1
          run_stage cast-sba CastPrioritySbaTest || failed=1
          run_stage death-trigger DeathTriggerTest || failed=1
          run_stage krarks-thumb KrarksThumbScenarioTest mtg-sets/2003-2007/tests || failed=1
          run_stage prismari PrismariTheInspirationScenarioTest mtg-sets/2026/tests || failed=1
          run_stage free-cast GrantNextSpellFreeCastTest || failed=1
          run_stage modal-cost ModalPerModeAdditionalCostTest || failed=1
          run_stage modal-cost-enumeration CastSpellEnumeratorModalAdditionalCostTest || failed=1
          run_stage reveal-cost RevealFromHandAdditionalCostTest || failed=1
          run_stage commander-choice CommanderZoneChoiceCheckTest || failed=1
          run_stage team-loss TwoHeadedGiantTeamLossTest || failed=1
          run_stage team-versus-team TeamVsTeamTest || failed=1
          exit "$failed"
      - name: Audit all original stages and exact receiving source
        if: always()
        run: python3 lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/collect-priority-receiving.py
      - name: Preserve complete validation evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: engine-priority-after-resolution
          path: build/reports/engine-priority-after-resolution/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
